 Around the NFL NFL Network: Lions' Aidan Hutchinson out for 2026 season with torn ACL
 Published: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter The Detroit Lions' worst-case scenario was realized on Monday as initial tests revealed star defensive end Aidan Hutchinson will miss the rest of the season due to a torn ACL in his right knee, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported.
 The Detroit pass rusher likely suffered additional damage in the knee, potentially to his meniscus, Rapoport added. He will undergo additional tests in the United States after receiving an initial MRI in Munich.
 Hutchinson suffered the injury in the first half of Sunday's blowout win over the Patriots in Germany while celebrating a third-down sack of Drake Maye .
 After taking down Maye to force a field goal on the first drive of the game, Hutchinson leapt in the air as he has done many other times to punctuate a sack. This time, however, Hutchinson's right knee buckled when he landed on the turf at Allianz Arena.
 Hutchinson was able to walk off the field with the Lions training staff, but he would not return to the game. Rapoport and NFL Network Insider Mike Garafolo reported after Detroit's' 35-10 win that Hutchinson was feared to have suffered a significant knee injury and it appeared unlikely that he would play again this season.
 Monday confirmed those reports, and now the Lions' bid for the franchise's first Super Bowl trip will continue without their top pass rusher.
 RELATED CONTENT
 Article NFL Network: Patriots QB Drake Maye could miss rest of 2026 season about 12 hours ago Article Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown put on a show for his 'home fans' in Germany about 24 hours ago Article NFL Network: Lions' Aidan Hutchinson feared to have suffered significant knee injury on sack celebration Nov 15, 2026 Hutchinson's six sacks are tied for second on the Lions and come after he posted a career-high 14.5 last year. His 19 QB hits are also first on Detroit but a wide margin, and Hutchinson's 50 pressures are second in the NFL, per Next Gen Stats.
 In short, there is no easy solve to replacing Hutchinson's impact on the Lions' defense, which is also without linebacker Jack Campbell .
 The Lions, however, were able to generate four sacks on Sunday after Hutchinson exited. Defensive end Derrick Moore had two, while  Alim McNeill and D.J. Wonnum added one each.
 McNeill recorded six pressures and a season-high three quick pressures (under 2.5 seconds) against the Pats as he continues to have a career year rushing the passer. McNeill has now recorded 35 pressures, 6.5 sacks, and 13 quick pressures this season, all career highs through Week 10 of any season, per Next Gen Stats.
 This marks the second time in three years that an injury will cut short Hutchinson's season prematurely after he missed 12 games in 2024 due to suffering a broken tibia and fibula. 
 The Lions (7-2) face the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 11.
